t: Dine tabshilim hammukanim meereb shabbat kede lehiggamer beshabbat
s: Dine tabshilim hammukanim meereb shabbat kede lehiggamer beshabbat ubo t"v seipim: kebar nitbaer besimman rn"g shebbasar chay muttar lehashhoto samuk lachasheka apillu betannur sheeno garup veqatum. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bimbushshal biqdera, sheenah memaheret lehitbashshel, umassiach dato mimmenna ad lemachar, ubekol hallayla yekola lehitbashshel belo chittuy baggechalim, vehu haddin betzali shennitzla biqdera. Abal betzali sheetzel haggechalim o sheal gabbe haggechalim — asur lehashhoto sham, apillu hu chay, vaapillu im hu battannur vekissa pi hattannur, lepi shehatztzali sheen qedera mapseqet beno laggechalim memaher hu litztzalot, veyukal lehiggamer sheyyehe rauy lisuddat hallayla, veyesh lachush shemma yishkach shehu shabbat veyasir kissuy hattannur veyachteh baggechalim ligmmor tzeliyyato. Ella im ken tach betit sebib hakkissuy, sheaz en chosheshim shemma yitrach kol kak listor hattichuy velo yizkor al hashshabbat, lepikak muttar lehashhoto betoko ben tzali sheal gabbe haggechalim, ben mebushshal biqdera, ben chay legamre, ben shehitchil litztzalot o lehitbashshel velo nitzla venitbashshel adayin kemaakal ben derusai:

Vekol zeh bibsar shor veez o ayil gadol vekayyotze bahem mimminim shebbesaram qasheh veen haruach mazziq lo, abal besar gedi veop vekayyotze bahem mimminim shebbesaram rak veharuach mazziq lo — muttar litzloto al haggechalim o etzel haggechalim betok hattannur mekusseh ap al pi sheeno tuach betit, ben shehu chay legamre ben shehitchil litztzalot velo nitzla kemaakal ben derusai, lepi shebbevadday lo yegalleh pi hattannur kede lachtot baggechalim, kevan sheharuach mazziq labbasar. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehaggedi vehaop hem menuttachim lachatikot, abal im hem shelemim en haruach mazziq lahem, vahare dinam kibsar shor veez. Vekol zeman shechalal haggup shalem, ap al pi sheen alayv rosho ukeraayv — niqra shalem leinyan zeh, shehatztzelaot meginnot alayv mibbipnim shello yazziq lo haruach. Umikkol maqom, im nitzla mibbeod yom mishshene tzedadayv kemaakal ben derusai — muttar lehashhoto apillu hu shalem, vaapillu besar shor veez, vaapillu chutz lattannur al haggechalim o etzel haggechalim. Veap lehaoserim lehashhot qedera bekira sheenah gerupa uqetuma kol zeman shemmitztammeq veyapeh lo, mikkol maqom betzali shemmunnach al gabbe haggechalim mammash — modim hem shemmuttar keshennitzla kemaakal ben derusai mibbeod yom, dekevan shehiggia lemaakal ben derusai, im yachteh baggechalim yacharok habbasar. Abal betzali sheeno al gabbe haggechalim mammash — asur lehashhoto sham, ella im ken nitzla kol kak mibbeod yom ad shehu mitztammeq vera lo, lehaoserim sham lehashhot qedera al gabbe kira kol zeman shemmitztammeq veyapeh lo. Ukebar nitbaer sham shehamminhag kehammattirin lehashhot qedera kol shennitbashla kemaakal ben derusai mibbeod yom. Ulepi zeh, muttar lehashhot hatztzali shennitzla kemaakal ben derusai mibbeod yom ap shehu chutz lattannur samuk laggechalim, vekol shekken al gabbe haggechalim mammash. Raq shetztzarik lizzaher sheyyamtin lehasir habbasar meal gabbe haggechalim beshabbat ad leachar shekkabu haggechalim, shello yekabbeh kelum besilluqo habbasar shealehem, sheeno domeh liqdera shemmuttar lesalleqah meal gabbe haggechalim beshshabbat kemo shennitbaer besimman rn"g, lepi sheen haqqedera mekabba otam kelal, abal habbasar mekabbeh otam qetzat (bammohal hannotep mimmennu) besilluqo mehem:

Im abar vehishha tzali shello nitzla kemaakal ben derusai bemaqom sheasur lehashhot, ben beshogeg ben bemezid — asur, ben lo ben laacherim, ad lemotzae shabbat bikde sheyyeasu. Umikkol maqom, im hishha betannur mekusseh, apillu eno tuach betit — muttar bediabad, apillu hu besar shor veez, lepi sheyyesh mattirim apillu lekattechilla, sheen chosheshim sheyyegalleh pi hattannur kede lachtot. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bediabad. Veken im hishha besar gedi menuttach vekayyotze bo etzel haggechalim velo al haggechalim mammash, ben betok hattannur apillu megulleh, ben chutz lattannur — yesh lehattir bediabad, lepi sheyyesh mattirim apillu lekattechilla, sheen chosheshim sheyyachteh baggechalim, dekevan shehabbasar hu rak, im yachteh baggechalim yitcharek habbasar, sheen tzarik ella chamimut haesh bilbad. Abal al gabbe haggechalim mammash, apillu besar gedi — asur ledibre hakkol, apillu bediabad, im lo nitzlah kemaakal ben derusai mibbeod yom, dekevan shehinnicho al gabbe haggechalim mammash eno choshesh ella sheyyitztzaleh mehera ap al pi sheyyitcharek, veshemma yachteh. Abal keshennitzla kemaakal ben derusai, meachar sherauy laakila qetzat — lamma yachteh lehapsido? Ulepikak, muttar apillu lehaoserim lekattechilla ap biqdera:

Perot hanneekalim chayyin, kegon tappuchim vekayyotze bahem — muttar litzlotam samuk lachasheka ap al pi sheen shahut sheyyitztzalu mibbeod yom. Umuttar lehashhotam apillu shello al gabbe haggechalim mammash, lepi minhagenu shennitbaer shekkol shennitzla kemaakal ben derusai muttar lehashhoto, uperot shenneekalim chayyin enan geruim mitztzali shennitzla kemaakal ben derusai. Umikkol maqom, beshabbat atzmah asur lehannicham bekol maqom sheyyukelu lehitchammem ad shehayyad soledet bo, vaapillu lesomkam etzel hattannur qodem sheyyussaq hattannur asur, ella im ken nitzlu kol tzorkan mibbeod yom, kemo shennitbaer besimman rn"g. Apillu im hitminam mibbeod yom etzel qedera chamma hamkussa bibgadim o bishar dabar sheeno mosip hebel, ubeshabbat napal hakkissuy — asur lehachaziro alehem im adayin lo nitbashshelu kol tzorkan vehayyad soledet sham. Veken asur lehosip od beged acher beshabbat, mippene shemmemaher ligmor bishshulam beshabbat:

Abal perot sheen neekalim keshehem chayyim, vaapillu batzal shellipamim okelim oto chay, mikkol maqom en tob leoklo chay kemo tappuchim vekayyotze bahem, vehu haddin kol dabar sheen tob leoklo chay — asur litzloto samuk lachasheka, ella im ken yesh shahut bayyom sheyyitztzaleh kemaakal ben derusai. Abal im lo nitzla kemaakal ben derusai mibbeod yom — asur lehashhoto bekol maqom sheasur lehashhot besar shor veez shello nitzla kemaakal ben derusai:

Asur litten samuk lachasheka pat lattannur shehaya bimehem ap al pi shehu garup veqatum, o letannur shellanu sheeno garup veqatum, velo charara al gabbe gechalim, ella im ken yesh shahut bayyom kede sheyyiqremu pene happat hamdubbaqim battannur upaneha shel tzad chalal hattannur, veken bacharara, sheaz en lachush shemma yachteh, shello yapsid happat. Veissa hamemullaa bebasar o bedagim (o bigbina) — tzarik sheyyiqremu paneha milmala umillematta veyitbashshel hammilluy shebbetokah kemaakal ben derusai. Vekol pat shenneepet kol kak ad sheim poresah en chutim nimshakim mimmenna, beyadua sheqqaremu paneha karauy, ayyen simman ts"a. Veyesh omerim sheezeh tzad happat sheqqaram techilla day bekak. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bediabad, sheim abar venatan pat lattannur samuk lachasheka velo qaremu ella paneha hamdubbaqim battannur, shemmin hassetam oto hatztzad qaram techilla, veken pene hacharara shelletzad haggechalim — muttar lo leoklah beshabbat. Abal im lo qaremu paneha kelal — asura ben lo ben laacherim ad lemotzae shabbat bikde sheyyeasu, apillu netanah samuk lachasheka mammash beinyan shekkayyotze bazeh gabbe basar shebbiqdera haya muttar apillu lekattechilla kevan shehu chay legamre samuk lachasheka, mikkol maqom bepat vekol kayyotze bazeh kegon uga umine batzeq sheopin biqdera — en zeh moil kelum, lepi shehen enan tzerikim shahut gadol laapiyyat[n] kemo shetztzarik lebishshul basar, vikolin hen lehiggamer sheyyehu reuyin lisuddat hallayla, veyesh lachush shemma yachteh baggechalim ligmor apiyyatan letzorek seuddat hallayla:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Shennetanah bemezid, abal im haya shogeg — muttar lo lirdot mimmenna kede mazon shalosh seuddot shel shabbat im en lo pat acheret leshabbat. Veyakol lomar laacherim sheen lahem pat leshabbat: "bou uredu lakem mazon shalosh seuddot". Ukeshehu rodeh — lo yirdeh bemirdeh, ella besakkin vekayyotze bo, shello yaaseh kederek shehu oseh bechol. Veim i epshar lo lirdot beshinnuy — yakol lirdot bemirdeh kedarko:

Velamma lo qanesu al hashshogeg kemo sheqqanesu al hammashheh tabshil beshogeg ap al pi sheen lo tabshil acher? Lepi sheen chiyyub kol kak leekol tabshil beshabbat, abal belo pat i epshar leqayyem mitzvat shalosh seuddot beshabbat, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ra"d. Umikkol maqom, im en lo mah leekol kelal beshabbat ki im oto hattabshil bilbad shehishha beshogeg — muttar lo leoklo mippene kebod hashshabbat, sheasur lehitannot bo, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman rp"ch. Veim yesh lo chatikat pat gedola maspeqet leshalosh seuddot — asur lo leekol beshabbat mippat zo shenneepet beissur kede lebarek al lechem mishneh shelemim, kevan sheiqqar mitzvat shalosh seuddot beshabbat yakol leqayyem belo pat zo:

Lo hitzriku lirdot beshinnuy ella keshenneepet beissur, abal im neepet behetter, kegon sheqqaremu paneha mibbeod yom, o betannur shellanu haggarup veqatum, o sheppi hattannur mekusseh vetuach betit, sheaz en lachush lechittuy kemo shennitbaer lemala — muttar lirdot bemirdeh kedarko, kevan shehu tzorek shabbat, sheen lo pat acheret. Abal im yesh lo pat acheret — asur lirdot apillu beshshinuy, sherdiyyat happat hi asura middibre soperim, velo hittiruha ella letzorek shabbat. Bameh debarim amurim? Betannurim shebbimehem, shehaya keen qedera vehayu madbiqim pat ledopne hattanur veshayyak bahem rediyya. Abal battannurim shellanu shehappat munnachat al shule hattannur — lo shayyak bahem kelal rediyya, umuttar lehotzi mehattannur kol happat shenneepet behetter, ap al pi sheyyesh lo pat acheret. Umikkol maqom, lo yotzi berachat, shello yaaseh kederek shehu oseh bechol, ella yitchob bah sakkin vekayyotze bo, o yotziah bemaqqel:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheddato leekol beshabbat mehappat shemmotzi, ap al pi sheeno tzarik lah, sheyyesh lo acheret. Abal im en dato leekol mimmenna — asur lehotziah apillu al yede shinnuy, sheasur lehakin mishshabbat lechol apillu beinyan sheen bo shum serek melaka ella tiltul bealma, kegon lehabi yayin mehammartep labbayit beshabbat letzorek habdala bemotzae shabbat, vekol kayotze bazeh, ukemo sheyyitbaer besimman tq"g leinyan yom tob, ayyen sham:

Apillu im en dato leekol mehappat beshabbat — asur littenah letannur shellanu sheeno garup veqatum samuk lachasheka kol kak sheen shahut sheyyiqremu paneha mibbeod yom, ap al pi shehu opeh otah letzorek motzae shabbat, ubekol hashshabbat kullah yekola leheapot belo chittuy, mikkol maqom chosheshim shemma yimmalek achar kak leoklah beshabbat, shehare muttar lo lehotziah mittannur shellanu sheen bo rediyya, vekevan sheyyihyeh dato aleha leoklah, shemma yishkach veyachteh baggechalim ligmor apiyyatah, shemmittaam zeh asur lehashhot tabshil letzorek seuddat shacharit bekol maqom sheasur lehashhoto letzorek seuddat hallayla, mishshum gezerat shemma yachteh, kemo shennitbaer besimman rn"g, ap al pi shead seuddat shacharit yukal lehitbashshel belo chittuy:

Mi shennatan pat lattannur beshabbat atzmah, ben beshogeg ben bemezid, venimlak lirdotah mehattannur qodem shetteapeh — muttar lo lirdotah, ap al pi sheen bah tzorek shabbat, shehare enah reuya laakila, vaapillu betannurim shellahem sheshshayyak bahem rediyya, shehittiru lo chakamim issur shel dibrehem kede shello yabo lide issur seqila o lide issur chattat. Umikkol maqom, im epshar lo lirdot al yede shinnuy — yeshanneh. Abal leadam acher lo hittiru lirdot apillu al yede shinnuy kede shello yabo chabero lide chiyyub chattat o seqila, sheen omerim leadam: "chate kede sheyyizkeh chabereka", kevan shechabero pasha bemah shennatan happat lattannur, ayyen sop simman sh"[v]:

Lo yemalle adam qedera asasiyyot veturemasin o shear kol mine qitniyyot veyanniach al gabbe kira o letok hattannur shellanu sheeno tuach betit im ena[n] gerupim uqetumim, ella im ken yesh shahut bayyom sheyyitbashshelu kemaakal ben derusai lepi minhagenu. Abal im en shahut bayyom kol kak — asur lehannichah sham apillu samuk lachasheka mammash, beinyan shekkayyotze bazeh bebasar muttar lehashhoto sham, kevan shehu chay legamre samuk lachasheka velo yukal lehiggamer od lisuddat hallayla, abal kol mine qitniyyot hem memaharim lehitbashshel, vikolin lehiggamer lisuddat hallayla. Veken haddin bekol mine yeraqot. Veim abar vehinnichah sham, ben beshogeg ben bemezid, velo nitbashshelu kemaakal ben derusai mibbeod yom — asurim ad lemotzae shabbat bikde sheyyeasu:

Veken haddin benoten mayim biqdera lechammemam letannur shellanu sheeno garup veqatum (letzorek shetiyya o apillu) letzorek hadachat kelim beshabbat, shetztzarik sheyyanniach sham haqqedera mibbeod yom kol kak sheyyehe shahut bayyom sheyyukelu lehitchammem chatzi hachimmum lekattechilla lepi minhagenu, o sheyyechammu kol tzorkam lehaoserim lehashhot sham tabshil shennitbashshel kemaakal ben derusai o apillu kol tzorko ad sheyyihyeh mitztammeq vera lo, vehammayim chammin gam ken mitztammeqin vera lahen. Abal lo yannichenna sham samuk lachasheka mammash, shehammayim gam ken hem memaharim lehitchammem. Veap shehammayim reuyim lishtiyya gam keshehem tzonenim, mikkol maqom enam tobim kol kakk keperot hanneekalim chayyim shennitbaer lemala. Veim abar vehinniach sham, ben beshogeg ben bemezid, velo nitchammemu shelish chimmumam mibbeod yom — asurim ad lemotzae shabbat bikde sheyyeasu:

Asur litten mayim samuk lachasheka letok qedera haqqebua betok tannur bet hachorep, ella im ken yesh shahut sheyyukelu lehitchammem chatzi chimmumam mibbeod yom, sheap shekkavvanato shello tibbaqa haqqedera, mikkol maqom kevan shechapetz gam ken bammayim hallalu sheyyitchammemu kede lehadiach bahem kelim beshabbat kemo shedderek hu lehadiach bahem — yesh lachush shemma yachteh baggechalim. (Veap al pi shemmuttar lismok etzel tannur sheeno garup veqatum kemo shennitbaer besimman rn"g, mikkol maqom kevan sheqqedera zo boletet al haggechalim shebbattannur — hare zeh kemashheh al gabbe haggechalim mammash). Veim abar venatan, apillu beshogeg, velo nitchammemu shelish chimmumam mibbeod yom — asur apillu lehadiach bahem kelim ad lemotzae shabbat bikde sheyyeasu. (Umikkol maqom, im netanam sham qodem shehussaq hattannur — epshar sheyyesh lehaqel im haya shogeg):
